name: LDV
overview: SAIC-owned commercial and utility marque, imported by Ateco Automotive, famous for the T60 dual-cab ute (and Australia's first electric ute, the eT60), G10 and Deliver 9 commercial vans.
australian_history: Originally the British Leyland DAF Vehicles (LDV) van manufacturer, the brand was acquired by Chinese automotive giant SAIC Motor and launched in Australia in 2013 via independent distributor Ateco Automotive. Beginning with the V80 commercial van, LDV expanded with the G10 van/people mover and scored a major Australian breakthrough with the T60 dual-cab ute in 2017—the first Chinese-manufactured ute to achieve a five-star ANCAP safety rating. LDV introduced the D90 7-seat 4WD SUV, the Deliver 9 large van, and made Australian automotive history in 2022 by releasing the LDV eT60, Australia's very first commercially available all-electric ute.

models.name: T60 & eT60
models.overview: The Chinese 1-tonne ute that disrupted the Australian market. Debuting in 2017 as the first Chinese-manufactured vehicle to achieve a 5-star ANCAP safety rating, the LDV T60 delivered unmatched equipment-for-price value. The 2021 T60 Max raised the stakes with a class-leading 160kW/500Nm 2.0L Bi-Turbo diesel, while the 2022 eT60 became Australia's first commercially available electric factory ute.

models.name: Deliver 9
models.overview: One of Australia's top-selling large commercial vans, challenging the Toyota HiAce and Ford Transit on fleet cost-efficiency.

t60.name: T60 & eT60
t60.overview: The Chinese 1-tonne ute that disrupted the Australian market. Debuting in 2017 as the first Chinese-manufactured vehicle to achieve a 5-star ANCAP safety rating, the LDV T60 delivered unmatched equipment-for-price value. The 2021 T60 Max raised the stakes with a class-leading 160kW/500Nm 2.0L Bi-Turbo diesel, while the 2022 eT60 became Australia's first commercially available electric factory ute.
t60.australian_market_notes: Distributed in Australia by Ateco Automotive since 2017. To tailor the ute for tough Australian roads, LDV engaged Walkinshaw Automotive Group in Clayton, Victoria to calibrate a bespoke Australian suspension tune for the Trailrider edition. The T60 Max has become a volume rival to Hilux and Ranger across Australian trade and fleet buyers.
